instruction: You are standing at the entrance of the room facing towards the cupboards, enter into the room. Turn right and move towards the open door. Move out of this room. Turn right you can see a narrow path, move in the path till you face an open door in front of you. Now enter into the room. Slightly turn left and move towards the bed. Now you are facing towards the bed. Turn left you can see a narrow path, enter into the path. Keep moving forward. Now you can see a photo frame to your left and you can see rest room in front of you. The position you are standing is your final destination.
